facts.fact: The policy cites data from the 2023 National Population and Housing Census, which found 4.4 percent of the population (about 108,992 people) living with a functional disability; the document gives no enumeration date, so the year 2023 is used.

The policy cites a 2011 Disability Report based on the 2011 National Population and Housing Census, published in 2016, with earlier counts for 1991 and 2001; the document gives no enumeration date, so the year 2011 is used.
